name: Universal TV Text Search Highlight
description: Adds an on-screen search box that highlights matching text on the page

params.code: var box = document.createElement('div'); box.id = 'tv-search-box'; box.style.cssText = 'display:none;position:fixed;top:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:999999;background:rgba(13,17,23,0.95);border:2px solid #58a6ff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;'; box.innerHTML = ''; document.body.appendChild(box); document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'f') { e.preventDefault(); box.style.display = box.style.display === 'flex' ? 'none' : 'flex'; if (box.style.display === 'flex') document.getElementById('tv-search-input').focus(); } }); document.getElementById('tv-search-input').addEventListener('input', function() { document.querySelectorAll('.tv-highlight').forEach(function(el) { el.outerHTML = el.textContent; }); var term = this.value.trim(); if (!term) { document.getElementById('tv-search-count').textContent = ''; return; } var regex = new RegExp('(' + term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + ')', 'gi'); var walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); var count = 0; var nodes = []; while (walker.nextNode()) { if (regex.test(walker.currentNode.textContent) && walker.currentNode.parentElement.id !== 'tv-search-input') nodes.push(walker.currentNode); } nodes.forEach(function(node) { var span = document.createElement('span'); span.innerHTML = node.textContent.replace(regex, '$1'); node.parentNode.replaceChild(span, node); count++; }); document.getElementById('tv-search-count').textContent = count + ' matches'; }); return 'search-ready';
